reader_question: How do I read the surviving temple and its later stories, then plan a visit without confusing heritage evidence with current arrangements?

inspection.used: World Heritage description and Outstanding Universal Value: patron, chariot design, surviving halls, reliefs and 1984 inscription. The page gives inconsistent horse counts; none is asserted here.
Odisha Review, September–October 2014, pp. 52–53. A secondary discussion of the Dharmapada legend and Gopabandhu’s poem, not evidence of how the temple was built. No verse is reproduced.
For the classical dance forms, open-air setting and usual 1–5 December dates. A general festival page is not a confirmed programme or booking for your visit.
For the nearby coast and sunrise setting. Beach access, sea conditions and transport require a local check.
Regional food descriptions and October–February travel guidance. These dishes are coastal food ideas, not claims of Konark origin or confirmed restaurant availability.

For the surviving buildings, sculptures recovered from the smaller brick temple and the published sunrise-to-sunset hours. The ticket portal inspected on 30 September listed the temple and site museum separately; no booking was made. Museum opening and accessible routes remain unconfirmed.
For arrival via Puri or Bhubaneswar and road connections. Its later published closing time conflicts with ASI’s daylight hours. Confirm the date-specific arrangements with ASI.
The official directory includes Konark. This is an enquiry lead; no contact or local service has been confirmed.

inspection_limits: UNESCO description, Outstanding Universal Value and inscription metadata read. Six/seven horse discrepancy preserved; no horse count asserted.
Acharya PDF text pp. 52–53 read: Dharmapada legend, Gopabandhu poem and patriotic reading. Original poem edition not inspected; no verse reproduced.
Current tourism festival overview used for forms, stage and usual dates only. Founder/origin, prices, show times and undated package claims not adopted.
ASI monument page read for surviving structures, recovered Balarama/Varaha/Trivikrama and daylight hours. Current Odisha Tourism page lists later hours; conflict stays visible.
ASI homepage web reader errored. Ticket-portal separate listings rely on explicitly dated 30 September inspection already in KB; no new portal inspection or booking claimed.
OTDC listing removed from current stay suggestion because operation was unconfirmed; original dated inspection preserved below.
